content.speaker: PERSON_1_STYLE_1
content.line: We're down to do, I guess sumo. It's a sumo oheya, I believe it is. To kinda just do some sumo wrestling and to put it in your repertoire to be a better fighter.
content.description: [PERSON_1_STYLE_1] speaks, initially as a voiceover over city scenes, then on-camera while riding in the back seat of a car, and returning to a voiceover. He explains the purpose of his visit in a calm, casual tone.

content.speaker: an unseen male guide
content.description: An off-screen male voice identifies the traditional sumo belt that PERSON_1_STYLE_2 is being fitted with by other wrestlers.

content.speaker: an unseen male guide
content.description: An off-camera male voice gives instructions as the wrestler tightly secures the belt around [PERSON_1_STYLE_2]'s waist.

content.speaker: multiple sumo wrestlers
content.description: Several sumo wrestlers shout short, rhythmic 'Yo!' vocalizations in unison while performing warm-up stomps and claps in the training ring.
Loud, resonant thuds as PERSON_1_STYLE_2 repeatedly strikes a large wooden pillar with his open palms and forearms during a conditioning drill.

content.speaker: PERSON_2
content.line: You have to cross your hands like this. And go, from right.
content.description: PERSON_2 demonstrates the correct hand-crossing technique on the wooden pillar and instructs PERSON_1_STYLE_2 on how to alternate strikes, speaking in accented English.

content.speaker: PERSON_2
content.line: You have to keep tucking your left hand. In, like that.
content.description: PERSON_2 continues to provide detailed instructions, emphasizing that after each strike, PERSON_1_STYLE_2 must pull that prominent arm back close to the body.

content.speaker: PERSON_1_STYLE_2
content.description: [PERSON_1_STYLE_2] responded to [PERSON_2]'s instructions with a brief affirmative reply, indicating that he understood the technique.

content.speaker: PERSON_4
content.line: You don't have to... you just jump this one. Do like this.
content.description: [PERSON_4] instructs the group of wrestlers, demonstrating a crouching technique while speaking in English with slight hesitation.
The loud noise caused by the collision between [PERSON_1_STYLE_2] and [PERSON_3] is followed by muffled groans, heavy breathing, and the sound of bare feet sliding quickly across muddy ground.

content.speaker: multiple sumo wrestlers
content.description: In sumo wrestling matches, the wrestlers surrounding the ring shout encouragement and tactical instructions in Japanese loudly and quickly, including "Ashi!" (feet/legs).

content.speaker: PERSON_1_STYLE_2
content.line: For myself that was the first time doing sumo, but very interesting. Probably put it in my technique at home. Um, I just gotta find some big guys.
content.description: [PERSON_1_STYLE_2] speaks directly to the camera while panting slightly from exertion. He reflects on his first sumo experience with a casual, somewhat amused tone, expressing interest in incorporating the techniques.
